summary: Finds the closest physics strut or collision node to a query point a2 using Euclidean squared distance plus a signed-distance plane test. When start node a3 is provided, walks its linked geometry lists (next pointers at +268/+272); otherwise initializes from a full-array scan. Global scan iterates this->strut array (0x134 base, 316-byte stride) while this->strutCount (0x130) > 0. Candidates passing the plane distance test sub_4FB6D0 are selected; called by VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate, Camera, PositionChangeMonitor, AIRacingLinePathFollowing and sub_4F1FE0 on the per-frame path.

operations.description: If start node a3 is non-null, initialize the linked-list nearest-neighbor walk from node at a3 (seed distance via offsets +0/+8) instead of the full-array scan path.
Walk linked geometry nodes via next pointers at +272 (and +268 on the second list) computing squared XZ distance to query point; retain the nearest node while the walk distance improves.
this->strutCount (0x130) > 0 enables the strut-array scan loop over all active struts; count <= 0 skips the scan.

Iterate strut entries at base this->strutData (0x134) with 316-byte stride; read entry type word at +300 and when type <= 1 compute squared distance to the query point with Y component weighted by 4.0, keeping the nearest candidate.
Call sub_4FB6D0(a2) to obtain the signed distance from the query point to the reference plane/surface; negative distance disqualifies early and returns the nearest node.

Plane-proximity scoring: for scan candidates when best plane distance is positive, re-call sub_4FB6D0 and accept the candidate if its distance improves bestPlaneDistance and its squared (distance+30) window is within bestSquaredDistance.
Final signed plane distance: if >= 0.0 return the plane-qualified candidate (v28), otherwise return the nearest raw node (v8).
